analyzed_vuln.description: `scope_new` reserves registers for `self` and all parsed locals by setting `s->sp = node_len(nlv)+1` and `s->nlocals = s->sp`, but leaves the zero-initialized `s->nregs` unchanged instead of updating it to at least `s->sp`. `scope_finish` publishes this understated `nregs`, and `mrb_vm_run` sizes the VM stack solely from `irep->nregs`. Bytecode can therefore address a valid local register beyond the allocated stack; in this PoV a VM register write reaches `regs[128]`, exactly past the initial 128-slot heap stack, causing the heap-buffer-overflow in `mrb_vm_exec`.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The fuzzer copies attacker bytes to a NUL-terminated string and passes them through `mrb_load_string`, so the parser/compiler build the local-variable list directly from the supplied Ruby source. A scope must accumulate enough distinct locals (128 in the implicated scope, yielding `nlocals=129` including self) and execute bytecode that writes the high local register, while subsequent expression pushes do not raise `nregs` above the initial 128-slot capacity. The PoV's very large malformed source causes this local-heavy scope; because `nregs` omits the registers pre-reserved in `scope_new`, `mrb_vm_run` does not extend the stack and the high-local write overflows it.

args: In mruby/mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c, does initializing codegen_scope::nregs to sp immediately after scope_new reserves self and parsed locals preserve the compiler's intended register-count invariant? Are there any special semantics suggesting nregs should exclude locals, or other scope construction paths that need the same initialization?

The sanitizer report shows a heap-buffer-overflow in mrb_vm_exec after a compiler-created irep contains nlocals=129 but an understated nregs. In scope_new at lines 3842-3844, the zeroed scope sets sp to node_len(nlv)+1 and nlocals=sp but leaves nregs at zero. push_n_ later only updates nregs when expression temporaries are pushed, while scope_finish publishes nregs directly to irep. I suspect the root fix is to establish nregs=sp in scope_new after reserving local slots, rather than changing the VM or masking the PoV. Please assess all construction paths and invariants.
